BFi.source:
function BFi takes integer H2,integer H3 returns integer
local integer Hy=BFd(H2,H3)
local integer H5=BFa(H3-H2)
return R2I(BFh()*(H5+1))+Hy
endfunction

BFj.source:
function BFj takes real H2,real H3 returns real
local real Hy=BFb(H2,H3)
local real H5=BFZ(H3-H2)
return Hy+H5*BFh()
endfunction

BeH.source:
function BeH takes real YD,real YE,real YF,real YG,real YH returns boolean
return YD>=YF-YH and YD<=YF+YH and YE>=YG-YH and YE<=YG+YH
endfunction

BeN.source:
function BeN takes integer JG,location Xp,real Is,integer Xq,boolean Xr returns nothing
local integer EK
local location It
local real X4
local real X5
local real X8=0
local real YB=0
local string YX
call BJI(JG,0,Xq-3,GetTriggerUnit(),"보물찾기")
set X4=GetLocationX(Xp)
set X5=GetLocationY(Xp)
if Xr then
call BeJ(JG,X4,X5)
endif
set EK=0
loop
exitwhen EK>=X7
set X8=X9[EK]
set YB=YC[EK]
if not (X8==0 and YB==0) then
if BeH(X8,YB,X4,X5,Is) then
if Xr then
set X9[EK]=0
set YC[EK]=0
call BeI(JG,X8,YB)
if YW[EK]!=null then
call DestroyEffect(YW[EK])
endif
else
set It=Location(X8,YB)
if YW[EK]==null then
if GetLocalPlayer()==Player(JG) then
set YX="war3mapImported\\Etc Quest To Me.mdx"
else
set YX=""
endif
set YW[EK]=AddSpecialEffectLoc(YX,It)
endif
call RemoveLocation(It)
call PingMinimapForPlayer(Player(JG),X8,YB,3)
endif
endif
endif
set EK=EK+1
endloop
call RemoveLocation(Xp)
set Xp=null
set It=null
endfunction

CCQ.source:
